title: [LOGGED OUT] "Follow us in social media!" shows 6 social links with the right targets

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner appeared a moment after load; clicked Dismiss and it closed.

steps.text: Scroll down to the "Follow us in social media!" section.
steps.saw: Section heading visible with icons below it.

steps.text: Are 6 social icons shown (YouTube, X, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, Facebook)?
steps.saw: 6 icons in order: YouTube, X, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, Facebook.

steps.text: Do the links point to the six expected URLs?
steps.saw: hrefs: https://www.youtube.com/@playludus, https://twitter.com/playludus, https://www.tiktok.com/@playludus, https://discord.gg/5qFQGUXQTD, https://www.instagram.com/play.ludus.game, https://www.facebook.com/play.ludus
